excerpt: Overview llama.cpp v1.1.0 adds the Inkling 2 family (base, Mini and DSpark), Domyn Edge 4B, Zaya1 8B, RAON-1-mini and Hy4 flash, splits DFlash speculative decoding into separate draft methods, and deprecates the old llama_batch API in favour of llama_batch_ext. It brings a large set of TTS and audio models (Kokoro, Zonos3-Mini, tiny-voca, VoxCPM2, MiniMax-Music3, YuE2, Fish S2, Higgs v3/VibeVoice-ASR and Kyutai Hibiki), token-aware chat parsing, named tool choice, automatic per-tensor quantization targeting a bpw or size budget, a slot-scheduling refactor in llama-server, a redesigned Llama Chat web UI with voice messages and agent traces, and updates ggml to v1.1.1. API changes llama.h: deprecate the old llama_batch API in favour of llama_batch_ext and llama_process (#32306, #32356) llama.h: add llama_dflash_variant and llama_model_dflash_variant() for the four DFlash draft heads (#32016) llama.h: add llama_model_meta_arr_n() and llama_model_meta_arr_str() to read GGUF string arrays (#32397) llama.h: add target_bpw, target_size, state_file and abort callback to llama_model_quantize_params (#15550) mtmd.h: add audio types for Zonos3, YuE2, MiniMax-Music3, Fish S2, Moshi, Kokoro, tiny-voca, VoxCPM2 (#32020, #32330, #32369, #32413, #32427, #32435, #32443, #32491) mtmd.h: add n_channels, mtmd_gen_audio_g2p() and mtmd_gen_state_get_ref_codes() (#32413, #32586) server: accept OpenAI named tool_choice and add GET /models/sse in single-model mode (#31564, #32398) server: add --ui-agent and --ui-mcp-proxy-allow-private-urls (#33004, #32633) New models Inkling 2 (text + vision), Inkling 2 DSpark and Inkling 2 Mini (#32217, #32218, #32694) Domyn Edge 4B: interleaved SWA with RoPE only on SWA layers and Q/K norm (#32559) Zaya1 8B (#32071) MiniMax-M3.1 (#32301) RAON-1-mini-preview: 30B-A4B MoE (#32176) Hy4 flash: 220B (12B active) text and vision on the DSA iSWA cache (#32960) DFlash2 for Recursive Ripple-65B-Preview (#31904) TTS: Kokoro, Zonos3-Mini and tiny-voca (#32413…
